messages.text: What coins can I mine with the Magic Miner 40T?

It's a SHA-256 machine, so Bitcoin is what it's built for. Any SHA-256 coin works in practice, Bitcoin Cash, eCash, BSV, since the algorithm is the same, but almost everyone runs it on BTC, solo to their own node or on a pool.

If you want Scrypt coins like Litecoin or Doge, that's different hardware, the 40T can't do those.

Planning to point it at BTC solo, or at a pool?
I see this model can do 4 coins at a time. So I was wondering which coins can it do

I don't want to guess at that one. The 40T's chip is SHA-256, so whatever it mines has to be a SHA-256 coin, but I can't tell you from here exactly which four the firmware lists or whether it's four pools rather than four coins.

JD knows the firmware side. I've put it to him, he picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and replies to (email hidden) Fastest route if you don't want to wait: our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate, that's JD.
